mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPI growth and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods with positive HOUST growth, or the correlation between HOUST growth and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies face production constraints and reduced earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over the previous quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect between RSAFS and GDPC1 growth rates on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect between PAYEMS and UNRATE on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than 3% over the previous quarter, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% & RSAFS growth > 3% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS growth rates on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
